_note: This file is a pure MMDetection3D configuration file containing only variable assignments (dicts/lists). It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines training config for ImVoxelNet on ScanNet with NeRF rendering in image mode using a ResNet50 backbone.
review_model_config: review the ImVoxelNet model config dict for ResNet50 backbone and FPN neck settings
review_train_pipeline: review the train_pipeline MultiViewPipeline config with 50 random images and nerf_target_views
review_test_pipeline: review the test_pipeline MultiViewPipeline config with 101 images for ScanNet evaluation
review_data_config: review the data dict config for ScanNetMultiViewDataset train val and test splits
review_optimizer_config: review the AdamW optimizer config with lr 0.0002 and backbone lr_mult 0.1
